blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Write the first three terms of the arithmetic sequence with the given information: \(a_1 = 2,\ d = 13\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein humein seedha pehli term \(a_1\) aur common difference \(d\) diye gaye hain.
Find kya karna hai? Pehli teen terms \(a_1, a_2, a_3\).
Plan: \(a_1\) se shuru kar ke do dafa \(d\) jama karna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1 = 2,\ d = 13\)
Humein find karna hai: \(a_1, a_2, a_3\).
Tareeqa: \(a_2 = a_1 + d\) aur \(a_3 = a_2 + d\). Chahein to general term \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) bhi laga sakte hain; dono ek hi baat hain.

Common difference jama karein
\[a_2 = 2 + 13 = 15\]
\[a_3 = 15 + 13 = 28\]
Kyun: A.P. ka matlab hi yeh hai ke har nayi term pichhli term mein \(d\) jama kar ke banti hai. Pehli term 2 to likhi hui hai, wohi pehli term bhi jawab ka hissa hai.
Dhyan dein: Bohat se students sirf \(a_2\) aur \(a_3\) likh dete hain aur \(a_1\) bhool jate hain; sawal pehli teen terms maangta hai, jin mein \(a_1\) bhi shamil hai.

Tasdeeq: formula se
\[a_3 = a_1 + 2d = 2 + 26 = 28 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(a_1\) se \(a_3\) tak do qadam hain, is liye \(d\) do dafa jama hota hai. Jawab wohi aaya.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Write the first three terms of the arithmetic sequence with the given information: \(a_1 = 12,\ d = -13\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh part (i) jaisa hi hai, lekin is dafa \(d\) negative hai. Iska matlab hai terms har qadam par chhoti hoti jayengi.
Find kya karna hai? \(a_1, a_2, a_3\).
Plan: \(-13\) do dafa jama karna, yani 13 do dafa minus karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1 = 12,\ d = -13\)
Humein find karna hai: \(a_1, a_2, a_3\).
Tareeqa: \(a_2 = a_1 + d\), \(a_3 = a_2 + d\). Formula wohi hai, sirf sign ka khayal rakhna hai.

Negative common difference jama karein
\[a_2 = 12 + (-13) = -1\]
\[a_3 = -1 + (-13) = -14\]
Kyun: Negative number jama karna minus karne ke barabar hai: \(12 - 13 = -1\). Phir \(-1 - 13 = -14\), kyunke do negative numbers jama hon to jawab aur zyada negative hota hai.
Dhyan dein: \(-1 - 13\) ko \(12\) ya \(-12\) likhna aam ghalti hai. Number line par socheiye: \(-1\) se 13 qadam baayein jayein to \(-14\) par pohanchte hain.

Tasdeeq: formula se
\[a_3 = 12 + 2(-13) = 12 - 26 = -14 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) mein \(n = 3\) rakha aur wohi teesri term mili.
